biocontainers.summary: Generate html or pdf reports for a set of genomic regions or deseq2/edger results

bioconductor.name: regionReport
bioconductor.summary: Generate HTML or PDF reports for a set of genomic regions or DESeq2/edgeR results
bioconductor.description: Generate HTML or PDF reports to explore a set of regions such as the results from annotation-agnostic expression analysis of RNA-seq data at base-pair resolution performed by derfinder. You can also create reports for DESeq2 or edgeR results.
bioconductor.author: Leonardo Collado-Torres [aut, cre] (ORCID: <https://orcid.org/0000-0003-2140-308X>), Andrew E. Jaffe [aut] (ORCID: <https://orcid.org/0000-0001-6886-1454>), Jeffrey T. Leek [aut, ths] (ORCID: <https://orcid.org/0000-0002-2873-2671>)
